ctx.x: Arstella Whitthers, who meanwhile on the suggestion of Lily, had changed her name for the pseudonyme of Martine Kay, had been engaged for the tour. But a few weeks before, she wrote that she was ill and could not make the tour. Lily tried to get in touch with her immediately as we had started to advertise her, but she couldn't be found nowhere. What had happened was that the girl had fallen in love and would not leave her boy friend for several months. Lily was very sore for business reasons and also because…

Somebody signalled us that there was a singer named Miriam Burton in town. Miriam had been the leading singer in Katerine Dunham's group fo singers and had beautiful suprano voice. She was not a jazz singer really, but on ballads, she was wonderful. So, we engaged her also.

We paid every musician a half day salary for rehearsing. That was a gesture that we decided to do in order to become better friends with the guys. We also put in the contract that everyone would be paid a half day salary whenever we had an off day during the tour. We had hired a bus and the driver was an ex-wrestler named Louis Lamy. He was a great guy and become a good friend and a big help for Lily on the tour. He owned the bus and had some others that he rented for tours.
